description.content: Adds the enter_plan_mode tool and reminds the agent to plan first for medium or complex tasks, delivering plan-mode guidance at the conversation tail so entering or leaving plan mode never rewrites the cached prompt prefix.
提供 enter_plan_mode 工具，并在中等或复杂任务上提醒 Agent 先规划；计划模式指引搬到对话尾部，进入或退出计划模式都不再重写已缓存的提示词前缀。
